catalysts.headline: One aggregator (MarketBeat) flags an unspecified 'key catalyst' for Corning dated Nov 11, 2026; no content, detail, or second-source corroboration was found this session

Multiple analysts revised price targets, apparently following a Q3 2026 earnings report: UBS lowered target to $192 from $201 (kept Buy); Morgan Stanley lowered target to $155 from $165 (Equal-weight); Truist lowered target to $175 from $182 (kept Buy); Barclays raised target to $132 from $129 (Equal-weight)

Corning reported Q3 2026 results, which the company says exceeded its own guidance: GAAP sales $4.86B, GAAP gross margin 37.3%, GAAP operating margin 18.8%, GAAP EPS $0.78, operating cash flow $1.06B; core sales $5.08B (+19% YoY, above the $4.9-5.0B guided range) and core EPS $0.91 (above the $0.85-0.89 guided range). The company said it signed four new long-term, multibillion-dollar customer agreements during the quarter, including with Verizon and AT&T. It issued Q4 2026 guidance of core sales $5.2-5.3B and core EPS $0.96-1.00.
